svg.title: Vale and Ila debate shortcuts as they leave the grievance counter.
svg.desc: Vale and Ila walk side by side, arguing that personal access is unequal and the formal route reaches nobody. Riju follows thoughtfully as Vale turns the problem towards emergency addresses.
svg.text: Page 7, panel 5 · Wide two-shot walking away from the grievance counter

text.tspan: Vale identifies the inequity of personal access; Ila
identifies the formal system's total failure.
